text: Building the rails between TradFi and digital assets: a conversation with BCB Group's Tim Renew on Crypto Minutes, Bloomberg TV. Re7's Founder & CIO Evgeny Gokhberg hosts a conversation with Tim Renew, CEO of BCB Group, on the infrastructure connecting traditional finance with digital assets. Watch the full episode below.
Crypto Minutes, Bloomberg TV: Evgeny Gokhberg in conversation with Joseph Chalom of Sharplink on going beyond holding ETH and working with active managers like Re7.

Re7 Capital hosts Crypto Minutes, the new Bloomberg TV show. Crypto Minutes is an interview series airing on Bloomberg TV, hosted by Evgeny Gokhberg, Founder & CIO of Re7 Capital. Across 20 short episodes, Evgeny puts these questions to leaders from the firms building the bridge between TradFi and DeFi. Featuring Joseph Chalom (Sharplink), Tim Renew (BCB Group), Peter Smith (Blockchain.com), David Schamis (Hyperliquid), Yuval Rooz (Canton Network), Guy Young (Ethena Labs), John Wang (Kalshi), Peter Mintzberg (Grayscale Investments), Alvise Saccomani (Banor Labs) and others.

Re7's Founder & CIO, Evgeny Gokhberg, will be speaking at Open by Monad, the flagship conference for the onchain economy, taking place on October 6th in Singapore. Evgeny joins a speaker lineup that includes Joseph Lubin (Consensys), Adam Levine (Fireblocks), Phil Sham (Aquanow), Kyung Baatenburg de Jong (Tether) and many more.
